item.title: Willie Colon, Grammy-nominated Salsa musician, dies at 75; family issues statement
item.description: Legendary Salsa musician Willie Colon breathed his last on Saturday morning. The Grammy-nominated musician was 75 years old. The family confirmed the news of his passing via social media post.

item.title: World Thinking Day: 7 subtle ways AI is changing how we think
item.description: Artificial intelligence is becoming an everyday companion, from drafting messages to making decisions faster than ever before. Backed by emerging psychology and technology research, this story explores seven subtle ways AI is reshaping us.

item.title: Lip flip, lip lift or lip filler? A plastic surgeon breaks down the biggest lip trends right now
item.description: Lip enhancement procedures are evolving rapidly, but choosing between lip fillers, lip flips, and lip lifts depends on age, facial structure and personal goals. Plastic surgeon Dr Anmol Chugh explains how each treatment works, who it suits best and why facial harmony matters more.

item.title: PM Modi in 131st Mann Ki Baat: AI Impact Summit a turning point, world amazed by India's innovations
item.description: In the 131st Mann Ki Baat, PM Modi highlighted India’s AI innovations for farmers and animal care, urged manufacturers and start-ups to aim for world-class quality, honoured organ donors, and promoted India’s cultural heritage and digital safety awareness.

item.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle to re-release in select theatres in ScreenX format
item.description: The Japanese action film Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – Infinity Castle will be re-releasing in theatres this March in the United Kingdom and North America. Find out when you can watch it again.

item.title: Why Gen Z and millennials are losing sleep and Ayurvedic ways to fix it
item.description: Insomnia is increasingly affecting young professionals navigating demanding careers, digital overload and irregular routines. Ayurveda expert Dr Partap Chauhan explains how disrupted biological rhythms and aggravated vata dosha are quietly damaging sleep quality.

item.title: Stern South African challenge beckons India as T20 World Cup defence enters business mode
item.description: India's title defence now enters the business mode as they face South Africa in their first Super Eight game in the T20 World Cup 2026. While, India are tipped to be strong contenders for the World Cup, the Proteas are pretty much equipped with the arsenal to deny them.

item.title: NCP chief Sharad Pawar admitted to hospital in Pune due to mild dehydration
item.description: Sharad Pawar was admitted to Ruby Hall Clinic in Pune on Sunday for mild dehydration, with doctors saying his condition is stable. He is expected to stay in the hospital for a couple of days before being discharged.

item.title: Rajat Sharma flags off marathon at Anandam Fest, shares message of fitness and well-being
item.description: A two-day Anandam Fest was held in Greater Kailash, New Delhi, featuring yoga, cultural programmes and a 4-km marathon. The marathon was flagged off by Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of India TV Rajat Sharma.

item.title: Rajat Sharma visits Delhi's Asita Ghat on LG's invitation, witnesses Yamuna's new look
item.description: At the invitation of Delhi's Lieutenant Governor, Vinay Kumar Saxena, Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of India TV Rajat Sharma visited Asita Ghat.
